Here are some of the best practices you can follow when starting your journey with <<prodname>> platform:

- Configure the [Tenant TimeZone](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/tenant-settings) and Date Format Settings for your tenant 

- Follow the ‘Principle of Least Privilege’ and leverage [role-based access control (RBAC)](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/user-roles-and-hierarchy) to limit user access to relevant features and capabilities.

- Configure [IP Address Allowlist](https://help.webexconnect.io/v6.20.0/docs/tenant-settings#ip-address-allowlist) to restrict API traffic for your tenant to trusted IPv4 addresses or CIDR ranges.

- Provide the ability to '[Decrypt Logs](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/teammates)' only to users who are authorised to access personally identifiable and other sensitive customer data

- Use a separate [service (i.e., a named workspace)](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/introduction) for handling each of your customer interactions/journeys instead of using a single service for all your flows.

- Use [Service Locking Feature](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/service-settings) to avoid unintended/accidental changes to your flows

- If you want to set up dedicated workspaces for different teams within your organization, use the [Clients, Groups, and Teams feature](https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/getting-started-groups-and-teams). Familiarize yourselves with the access restrictions that apply to various assets and features when you segregate users across Groups and Teams.

- Follow communication best practices, such as: 
  - [Contact Policy Module](https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/contact-policy)  to store customer consent information for various communication purposes
  - [Managing Email Unsubscribes ](https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/email#managing-email-unsubscribes) to add an unsubscribe URL to the emails sent via Webex Connect  platform.
  - Handling customer unsubscribes / [STOP responses over SMS with Reserved Keywords](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/phone-numbers#reserved-keywords), etc to opt out the SMS subscription.

- You can access your <<prodname>> account from any standard web browser simply by typing in the URL (provided by the account manager). However, we recommend using the latest versions of Google Chrome, Firefox, and Safari for the best experience.
